newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bank Austria super board to discuss CA bid-agency.
newsitem.headline: Bank Austria super board to discuss CA bid-agency.

text.p: Bank Austria's supervisory board will discuss making an offer for Creditanstalt-Bankverein at a supervisory board meeting later on Wednesday, Austrian news agency APA reported.
Quoting Bank Austria spokesman Heimo Hackel, APA said the meeting, which begins at 1500 GMT, would consider a bid for the state's 70 percent of ordinary voting shares in Creditanstalt.
Earlier a source close to the supervisory board confirmed to Reuters that Bank Austria was poised to buy into Creditanstalt. -- Janet McBride, Vienna Newsroom 43-1-531 12 254
